coreDecision.decision: Stairs are enclosed level-change portals; the lift is the step-free route. The reserved 5 x 6 m core is kept.
coreDecision.measured: A code-like switchback (risers <= 0.18 m, goings >= 0.28 m, two 1.2 m flights) needs about 2.6 x 7.0 m for a 4 m storey and 2.6 x 8.4 m for the 5 m ground storey. With a 2.2 m lift shaft and a 2 m lobby meeting the 3 m spur, the core would grow to about 5 x 9.4 m.
coreDecision.effectIfAdopted: Extending each core 3.4 m north would remove about 8.5 m x 3.4 m = 28.9 m2 of lettable west-band suite per upper floor (19 floors, about 549 m2 campus-wide) and move every core spur. Not adopted; #508 may revise the core under a new layout version if walked stairs are required.

policy.public: Ground paths, the F1 halls, every core lobby and spur, every spine, terrace passage, terrace and roof garden, and both skywalks are public. Crossing the campus never needs a lease.
policy.private: Suites are private and branch off public spines by one door each. No suite is ever part of the public route.
policy.levels: F1 is the ground floor at z 0. F4 finished floor and both skywalk decks are z 13. Floor ids are <tower>-F<level>; suite numbers are <tower>-<level><nn>.
policy.support: A position resolves against the surface its occupant is on (ground, a floor, a terrace, a roof or a deck), never the highest surface at that point. Level changes only through declared portals.
policy.commercialTerms: Unset by this contract: pricing, currency, period, operator, payment provider, refunds and cancellation belong to #509.
